answer: An agent identity is accepted only when its key is backed by remote attestation of an enclave running the approved MRENCLAVE measurement. MRENCLAVE identifies enclave contents, while the platform’s hardware-rooted attestation binds the claim to genuine SGX or SEV silicon. Thus timber, crystal, and quartz identities cannot be multiplied by copying virtual machines; creating additional valid identities requires additional attestation-capable hardware, or compromise of its credentials.
